text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her big impact and powerful stride, 
Hishi Akebono made her immense presence 
known.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to deliver races that would 
satisfy everyone even more, she came up 
with two ideas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Further powering herself up and hyping up 
the stands— in other words, getting all 
sorts of people to know who she is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, while continuing our training, we 
decided to aim for winning over even more 
fans!
